answer: Registration happens in the tide, the epochal registry where every newcomer needs three sponsors sharing no lineage with it. Each fake identity is one ember, and clones cannot sponsor each other — the tide rejects any pair with shared history. Each sponsor locks jade behind its ember, burned if the clone is exposed, so outsiders charge rising prices as the attacker drains the finite pool of unrelated sponsors; the thousandth ember costs more jade than the first, and a drained pool cannot be split or parallelized. Break: off-ledger collusion hides kinship.
